title: keel approval record
description: A Board approval record: the explicit confirmation of one shown subject at one content version, committed at .keel/approvals/<record-sha256>.<kind>.json (id AP-<sha12>). keel approve shows the subject and its change, the Board confirms explicitly, and the Steward writes the record with the normalized content hash of every bound artifact, the declared approver and the local approval time, then appends the approval.recorded event under the ledger writer lock. An approval is valid only while every bound artifact still hashes to the recorded value; any change to approved content invalidates it and needs a fresh look and a fresh confirmation. The hash binds content, the approver is a declared local identity and the time is the local clock: none of them is a cryptographic identity or an anti-forgery proof (docs/14-trust-security.md). A record that keel approve did not write, and seat output or drops that claim approval, are never an approval.

subject.description: What is approved: a proposal or task id, a document path, a policy name, a question id or a record id. The confirmation applies to this subject at the recorded content version only.

commit.description:
Commit the artifacts were hashed at: keel/

/main for stages, trunk for documents.

artifacts.description: Every approved artifact with the sha256 of its normalized blob (src/core/normalize.ts). These hashes are what the approval covers: a change to any of them invalidates the approval; a change elsewhere does not. The record itself is never among them. Empty for a request record, whose bound content is the request text.

request.description: The verbatim request, for request records (keel new --policy).

note.description: Optional Board commentary typed at confirmation (--note); shown in receipts and the trace output.

ledger_chain_head.description: Hash of the last ledger event when the record was written, for consistency checks: a later edit of events before this head is detectable. Null only when the ledger has no event yet (the first document approval after keel init).

approved_at.description: The local machine time at confirmation, as recorded by keel approve; not a trusted timestamp.

approvalKind.description: stage: contract, plan, land or receipt checkpoint; doc: a governance document (charter, goals, routing); policy: a standing policy; request: a policy-path change request; rule: a ruling.

sha256.description: sha256 of the normalized blob at commit.

clause.description: Clause, finding or question the ruling settles.

budget.description: Set for a budget ruling (keel approve <subject> --rule budget --limit <usd|runs|wall_minutes>=<n>): the new limit for the approval subject (a goal, proposal or task); null otherwise.

track.description:
Set for a track ruling (keel approve

--rule track --to ): the recorded track and the track the Board sets; null otherwise.

landBinding.description: What a land approval binds. The landed commit is recorded later in the land.completed event.

receipt_draft.description: sha256 of the receipt draft the Board read.

familyPair.description: The declared engineer families (the build route and, when a test task runs, the test route) and the reviewer family: a declaration, never a verified fact.

engineer.description: Declared families of every engineer route the proposal uses; the reviewer family must differ from each.

independence.description: degraded needs keel approve --rule degraded for the change.

approver.description: The declared local identity of the Board member who confirmed: the approver name from the personal layer .keel/local.yaml (board.approver), or the name typed at confirmation when none is configured. A recorded name, not an authenticated one.
